data.narrative:
Havoc AI is a Series A-stage company operating in ocean and maritime technology, founded by Paul Lwin and Joe Turner. The company has raised $200M to date. The relevant peer set consists of two private-market comparables in the same sector—Seasats and Bedrock Ocean—with no public traded peers available for direct benchmarking.

Valuation analysis relies on a stage-progression methodology, which applies a 2.0x step-up multiplier typical of Series A advancement dynamics. Using the $200M total raised as a value proxy and applying the 2.0x multiplier yields an implied valuation of $400M. This method is applicable given the company's defined stage and capital history, though the constraint of a single methodological pillar—absent revenue multiples, DCF, or public comparables—limits triangulation depth.

The analysis supports a valuation range of $340M (low) to $460M (high), with a median point of $400M. Key uncertainties include the absence of public market reference points for the ocean and maritime sector, reliance on only two private peer observations, and limited visibility into unit economics or revenue metrics. Substantive refinement would require disclosure of revenue run-rate, gross margin profile, or customer concentration data to anchor alternative valuation frameworks.
